chapter: Jazz at the Philharmonic and the record business
title: Detroit JATP date, back to California and forming a band
summary: After Chicago and New York he returns for Granz's Detroit date, then forms a band in California.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Well, in this whole period, of course, you said you came back to New York with Bird, but you started doing your own thing then...
You mean after I left Bird?
Yeah, and you both came back East in '47.
You had already, of course, recorded for Dial. Isn't that about the time you put your own group together?
Yeah. Well, I had my own group together before that.

Well, I didn't desert the band. I just came out East because I wanted to see Fats, and I wanted to come to New York anyway just to see what the scene was like. So that's why I came here after we played Chicago. I didn't have no job here; I just came here to hang out and to see what the scene was like.

After that I had to go back and join... Norman called me and asked me would I do the Detroit thing, because he figured he could draw a lot of people there because I'm from Detroit, and most of the cats there knew me and they knew I

was from Detroit, so they would come in to see me. That's what he thought. So he had my picture on the front page of the paper and everything. So that's what made his nut for him. But I was on my way back to California, but I had to stop in Chicago, because I had an important engagement there and...
Did you play at the Argyle with your own band?
It was not that much later.

Yeah, it was later on, but not right at that time. At that time, I was just going through Chicago, because like I said, I had a hot date, but it was only just... It wasn't for Norman or nobody; it just was for a gig.

And I went on back out to California, and I formed a band, and I stayed out there until the Fall of the year -- that's when I had to come back with Norman and do a tour with Norman. And I came back here to New York... No, I moved back here to New York; that's right.
